tools.name: sdl_strategy_plan
tools.description: Deterministic public strategy planner. Builds ordered steps, warnings, live checks, and step output references for one supported route.

amount_link.description: Optional LINK amount to thread into the plan.

amount_sdl.description: Optional SDL amount to thread into the Uniswap V3 strategy plan.

amount_link_min.description: Optional LINK minimum for the Uniswap LP builder step.

amount_sdl_min.description: Optional SDL minimum for the Uniswap LP builder step.

allow_zero_mins.description: Optional explicit acknowledgement for zero-minimum Uniswap LP minting. Only use this when you intentionally accept that risk.

wallet.description: Optional wallet address for pre-filled builder calls.

slippage_bps.description: Optional slippage guard for swap and LP steps. Default: 50.

slippage_bps.description: Slippage guard in basis points. Default: 50.

amount_link.description: LINK leg amount in human-readable form.

amount_stlink.description: stLINK leg amount in human-readable form.

slippage_bps.description: Slippage guard in basis points. Default: 50.

amount_lp.description: Curve LP token amount in human-readable form.

tools.name: sdl_build_uniswap_v3_lp
tools.description: Build an unsigned mint for the canonical LINK and SDL Uniswap V3 LP NFT. This does not include NFT staking.

amount_link.description: LINK leg amount in human-readable form.

amount_sdl.description: SDL leg amount in human-readable form.

amount_link_min.description: Optional minimum LINK to deploy into the position. Provide together with amount_sdl_min.

amount_sdl_min.description: Optional minimum SDL to deploy into the position. Provide together with amount_link_min.

allow_zero_mins.description: Set true to explicitly acknowledge zero minimums if you are not providing min amounts.
